## Summary

## Consent and provenance

- [ ] No unconfirmed candidate can use a personal voice.
- [ ] Only explicit patient confirmation can create Gold memory.
- [ ] Caregiver, system, and AI context retain distinct provenance.
- [ ] Silence, timeout, confidence, and device presence are not consent.
- [ ] Rejection does not become a preference.
- [ ] High-risk and cross-patient behavior were considered.
